timeline.summary: Tawnos creates clay warriors; Urza promotes him from apprentice to master.
timeline.quote: Urza ended his apprenticeship, promoting him directly to the rank of master.

citation.text: Clay Statue (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tawnos cracks the puzzle of Mishra's structures.
timeline.quote: Tawnos finally cracked the puzzle: the strange structures did not house Mishra's malevolent creations but were themselves among his creations.

citation.text: Ankh of Mishra (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza promotes Tawnos directly to master after the Clay Statue warriors.
timeline.quote: After he created these warriors, Urza ended his apprenticeship, promoting him directly to the rank of master.

citation.text: Clay Statue (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tawnos's weaponry replaces costly war machines.
timeline.quote: When war machines became too costly, Tawnos's weaponry replaced them.

citation.text: Tawnos's Weaponry (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tawnos is promoted from apprentice to master artificer.
timeline.quote: His speed and flexibility quickly earned him promotion from apprentice to master artificer.

citation.text: Tawnos (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza says he sealed himself in a walking crypt of armor.
timeline.quote: I sealed myself in a walking crypt.

citation.text: Urza's Armor (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tawnos solves the puzzle that the structures were Mishra's creations.
timeline.quote: Tawnos finally cracked the puzzle

citation.text: Ankh of Mishra (Classic Sixth Edition, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tawnos, frostbitten and aged, arrives for a private meeting and Kayla tells him she thought he was dead.
timeline.quote: I thought you were dead.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tawnos says Urza stopped a demon from taking the world after his brother was turned and fused with a machine.
timeline.quote: Turned by that creature. Fused with a machine.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla confronts Tawnos about the death of her son Harbin and says she will never forgive him.
timeline.quote: I will never forgive you for convincing me to allow my son to go off and die in my husband's war.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tawnos shows Urza's and his own designs, says he recovered powerstones and knows where Argive's buried stockpile lies, and offers to build tools to rebuild Penregon.
timeline.quote: I was able to recover a clutch of powerstones and know where we can find more.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tawnos reveals that Urza is not dead but has become something else.
timeline.quote: Urza is not dead, ma'am.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla sends Tawnos to Urza's old factories with Myrel so he can begin building.
timeline.quote: Tomorrow, I will have Myrel, my scout captain, take you to the warehouses so you can begin.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Months later Myrel reports a ten-thousand-strong ragged march approaching, flying black banners and carrying machine remains and Ashnod's transmogrants; Tawnos says his civils can be armed.
timeline.quote: My best assumption is ten thousand

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Talites in the market attack one of Tawnos's civils; two pilgrims die in the guards' response, a guard is wounded and the rest are arrested.
timeline.quote: Two of the pilgrims are dead and one of our guards was wounded.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla orders Tawnos to arm the civils and Myrel to levy the militia.
timeline.quote: Tawnos, arm the civils,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla remembers fleeing the fall of Kroog while pregnant.
timeline.quote: She fled the city, pregnant with her son.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 1: The End" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: In his factory, Tawnos realizes his civils were built from Urza's war machines and that Penregon's powerstones will run out, making war inevitable.
timeline.quote: Tawnos realized that Penregon's stockpile would dry out in the coming years.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tawnos tears pages of his toy designs from his own notebook and sets fire to his office.
timeline.quote: No one on the factory floor saw the fire until it was too late.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla and Myrel survey the burned factory and conclude that Tawnos set the fire himself and vanished.
timeline.quote: Tawnos did this,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tawnos promotes the five cadets to full pilots and briefs them on the Mardun crossing and Mishra's dragon engines.
timeline.quote: The first waves of Mishra's force have crossed the Mardun; they control the River Wards.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Tawnos orders the avengers to take down the dragon engines and tells the pilots to run if in danger, heading to Hench.
timeline.quote: We need you and your avengers to take down the dragon engines,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: A huge explosion and a dragon engine appear over the city as Tawnos hurries away.
timeline.quote: Roiling crimson smoke leapt into the sky.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Laria tells Aiman that Tawnos has brought a dozen units of Clay Soldiers, so the Argivians know the attack is coming.
timeline.quote: Laria said they know our attack is coming.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Urza opens Tawnos's coffin on the wrecked coast, says the war is over and his brother is dead, and sends Tawnos west to teach.
timeline.quote: Tell them what happened here. Tell them what we did, and what we failed to do.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Urza reveals his gem eyes and fades away, quoting Kayla's message to remember him as he tried to be; Tawnos walks inland as snow begins to fall.
timeline.quote: As you were, but as you tried to be,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: During the Fall of Kroog, Tawnos frees Ashnod to protect Kayla, and Ashnod kills the Qadir with the staff and helps Tawnos and Kayla escape by boat.
timeline.quote: The Qadir himself she made sure to kill, draining his life with the staff such that he collapsed, bleeding.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at Argoth Ashnod passes the sylex to Tawnos and holds off Gix while Urza activates it.
timeline.quote: Ashnod passed the sylex to Tawnos , who conveyed it to Urza while she held off the Phyrexian demon.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod survives the blast, changes her appearance and name, and by 80 AR founds the Conclave of Mages with Tawnos as Nod.
timeline.quote: she had founded a school of mages and artificers near Ronom Lake with Tawnos.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza says a final farewell to Tawnos and leaves Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Urza departed Dominaria after saying a final farewell to his student and good friend Tawnos

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at Argoth Ashnod passes the Sylex to Tawnos, who conveys it and its detonation process to Urza.
timeline.quote: Ashnod passed the sylex to Tawnos , who conveyed it and its detonation process to Urza.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Kayla grow close after her father's death.
timeline.quote: the couple grew closer

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Life with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kayla rules Penregon, rebuilds with Tawnos's automatons, and the Church of Tal besieges the city.
timeline.quote: initiated the Siege of Penregon in 69 AR

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Penregon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tawnos destroys Urza's archives and leaves, ending the age of artifice in Penregon.
timeline.quote: the repentant Tawnos destroyed Urza's archives and left the city

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Penregon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Fall of Kroog, Tawnos frees Ashnod and returns the Staff of Zegon so she will protect Kayla.
timeline.quote: Ashnod was let free by Tawnos

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod drains the Qadir's life with the Staff of Zegon, killing him, and Mishra becomes the last Qadir.
timeline.quote: Mishra himself became the last Qadir.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tawnos travels to Kroog and lures Urza from his work with a snake toy, becoming his apprentice.
timeline.quote: He successfully dragged the Chief Artificer away from his work at the Yotian laboratory by presenting him with a self-made snake toy.

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After creating clay warrior golems, Tawnos is promoted from apprentice to master.
timeline.quote: Urza promoted him directly from apprentice to master.

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at Argoth, Ashnod passes the Sylex to Tawnos while she holds Gix back.
timeline.quote: They were attacked by Gix , but Ashnod passed the Sylex to Tawnos

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tawnos survives the Sylex Blast sealed in the Stasis Coffin and remains there five years until Urza releases him.
timeline.quote: He remained there for 5 years until the ascended Urza released him.

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tawnos helps Kayla defend Penregon against the Church of Tal's siege.
timeline.quote: helped her to defend the city against the Church of Tal 's Siege of Penregon later that year.

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tawnos burns his notes on artifice and disappears from the city.
timeline.quote: he burned his library of notes on artifice and disappeared from the city

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tawnos and Ashnod found the Conclave of Mages near Ronom Lake.
timeline.quote: By 80 AR, he had reconnected with Ashnod

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On his deathbed Tawnos writes scraps of parchment about Urza's mightstone and weakstone.
timeline.quote: On his deathbed some years later, he wrote four scraps of parchment

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza allies with Kroog and spreads influence over Yotia while Mishra works the west and Zegon, where Ashnod joins him as a harsh overlord.
timeline.quote: Eventually, Ashnod joined him, but what a different Ashnod she was!

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the final months-long battle at Argoth, Urza and Tawnos emerge victorious and the island is a smoking ruin.
timeline.quote: When he battle was over, Urza and Tawnos emerged victorious, and Argoth was a smoking ruin.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Ashnod are almost certainly killed, while Urza and Tawnos disappear, perhaps by planeswalking.
timeline.quote: Mishra and Ashnod were almost certainly killed in the conflagration, but no concrete evidence exists of this.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza wins the Warlord's daughter's hand in Yotia and takes Tawnos as apprentice, while Mishra tames a dragon engine with the Weakstone and unites the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: Mishra discovers a dragon engine war machine and tames it with his Weakstone.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod gives Tawnos the Sylex and sacrifices herself to delay Gix.
timeline.quote: Ashnod delays him long enough to let Tawnos escape at the cost of her life

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza tells Tawnos that Mishra is dead, killed years earlier by the Phyrexian demon, and says he must leave Terisiare.
timeline.quote: tells him that Mishra is dead but that the demon from Phyrexia had killed his brother years ago

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Drafna founds the City of Shadows; Ashnod and Tawnos found a hidden school that becomes the Conclave of Mages.
timeline.quote: A hidden school of magic had been founded there by Ashnod and Tawnos in 80 AR

citation.text: "Third Path", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod helps the captured Tawnos escape; the Brotherhood of Gix persuades Mishra to banish her.
timeline.quote: The Brotherhood of Gix discovers this and persuades Mishra to banish her.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Harbin discovers Argoth and the Combined Kingdoms invade it; Gix lures Urza and Mishra there.
timeline.quote: Gix also lures Urza and Mishra to Argoth in order to make them face each other physically.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the last battle, Gix drives artifact creatures mad, Ashnod hands the Sylex to Tawnos, who gives it to Urza, and Mishra is revealed as altered by Phyrexian constructs.
timeline.quote: Mishra is revealed to have been altered by Phyrexian constructs.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Six years later Urza returns to say farewell to Tawnos and asks him to return to Kayla.
timeline.quote: Urza returned to Dominaria to say a final farewell to his student and good friend Tawnos

citation.text: "Urza", section "Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
